entities.summary: Zeeshan Ashraf Qasmi is a former field hockey full back player from Pakistan. He made his international debut for Pakistan in 2001. He captained the national side during the 2008 Beijing Olympics and the 2010 Hockey World Cup. He was also the flag bearer for Pakistan at the 2008 Olympic opening ceremony. His leadership in the 2010 Asian Games secured Pakistan a direct berth for the 2012 London Olympics. Zeeshan Ashraf was a athletes & competitors from Quetta (b. 1977-02-28, Quetta).
